ui.delete-this-layer-undo-restores-it: Delete this layer. Undo restores it.
ui.add-remove-rename-and-reorder-support: Add, remove, rename and reorder support Undo.
ui.the-layer-list-changed-reload-this-ed: The layer list changed. Reload this editor before applying names.
ui.name: Name
ui.folder-names-organize-the-layer-list-: Folder names organize the layer list locally; they do not create hardware layers. IDs remain stable when layers are removed.
ui.names-and-folders-save-on-enter-or-wh: Names and folders save on Enter or when leaving the field. Undo restores previous values.
ui.drop-a-layer-here-to-move-it-out-of-i: Drop a layer here to move it out of its folder.
ui.keep-all-layers-and-move-them-to-the-: Keep all layers and move them to the root.
ui.click-select-contents-shift-click-tog: Click: select contents · Shift-click: toggle selection · double-click: rename · drag: reorder folder
ui.use-a-nonempty-unique-folder-name: Use a nonempty, unique folder name.
ui.read-the-clipboard-and-review-layer-m: Read the clipboard and review layer mapping. Ctrl/Cmd-V also works.
ui.enable-snapping-with-the-magnet-optio: Enable snapping with the magnet options to snap to the grid.
ui.equal-divisions-of-the-output-visibil: Equal divisions of the output. Visibility and snapping are independent.
ui.includes-contact-between-mirrored-opp: Includes contact between mirrored/opposite resizing layers.
ui.alt-invert-snapping-shift-10-px-ctrl-: Alt: invert snapping · Shift: 10 px · Ctrl+Shift: 100 px
ui.updates-immediately-leave-blank-to-hi: Updates immediately. Leave blank to hide the title.
ui.the-reference-image-replaces-this-exa: The reference image replaces this example backdrop.
ui.choose-a-theme-your-three-most-recent: Choose a theme. Your three most recent choices stay in the menu.
ui.select-a-layer-to-edit-its-properties: Select a layer to edit its properties.
ui.show-source-patterns-on-other-layers-: Show source patterns on other layers while cropping
ui.themes-also-apply-to-the-viewport-imp: Themes also apply to the viewport. Imported pictures retain their colors.
ui.applies-to-layer-handles-and-numeric-: Applies to layer handles and numeric width/height edits. Crop zoom always keeps the source proportions.
ui.applies-to-layer-movement-resize-not-: Applies to layer movement/resize, not numeric entry or crop-content handles.
ui.ctrl-temporarily-invert-pivot-tool-dr: Ctrl: temporarily invert Pivot tool · Drag pivot to position
ui.double-click-pivot-reset-to-center-sh: Double-click pivot: reset to center · Shift/Ctrl+Shift: invert matching grid tool
ui.arrow-keys-move-1-pixel-shift-arrow-m: Arrow keys: move 1 pixel · Shift-arrow: move 10 pixels
ui.shift-click-add-remove-a-layer-from-s: Shift-click: add/remove a layer from selection
ui.tools-v-move-h-pan-z-zoom-outside-tex: Tools: V Move · H Pan · Z Zoom (outside text fields)
ui.space-drag-or-middle-button-pan-scrol: Space-drag or middle button: pan · Scroll: zoom
ui.double-click-a-layer-adjust-crop-esca: Double-click a layer: adjust crop · Escape: cancel gesture
ui.image-placement-visibility-and-opacit: Image placement, visibility and opacity belong to the current project.
ui.png-jpeg-and-bmp-drop-a-picture-into-: PNG, JPEG and BMP. Drop a picture into the viewport to import it.
ui.application-settings-save-automatical: Application settings save automatically when changed.
ui.project-json-stores-layout-sources-cr: Project JSON stores layout, sources, crops and the reference picture. Exchange exports store layer geometry.
ui.opening-a-project-may-restore-its-vie: Opening a project may restore its viewport options without rewriting your startup defaults.
ui.read-preview-layer-containers-from-a-: Read Preview layer containers from a supported Midra 4K or Aquilon device and review their mapping before import.
ui.read-snapshots-and-explicitly-send-re: Read snapshots and explicitly send reviewed size, position and crop changes.
ui.changes-take-effect-immediately-and-s: Changes take effect immediately and save automatically.
ui.enter-width-height-width-height-or-a-: Enter width:height, width/height or a decimal. With aspect lock on, keeps width and adjusts height.
ui.starting-a-new-project-replaces-the-r: Starting a new project replaces the recovery autosave. Current edits will be lost unless saved to a separate project file.
ui.autosave-does-not-count-as-a-manual-s: Autosave does not count as a manual save. Only applied edits are saved; pending drafts will be discarded.
ui.fixed-reference-image-double-click-fo: Fixed reference image · double-click for settings · right-click for actions
ui.signal-status-comes-from-the-last-con: Signal status comes from the last connection refresh.
ui.configure-capture-to-choose-an-input: Configure capture to choose an input.
ui.fetch-the-selected-input-and-replace-: Fetch the selected input and replace this layer's preview directly.
ui.one-input-per-interval-across-automat: One input per interval across automatic previews; shared inputs use one request. Leave auto-refresh off to keep a still.
ui.connect-to-a-device-to-choose-and-cap: Connect to a device to choose and capture an input.
ui.choose-an-input-to-capture-its-first-: Choose an input to capture its first still automatically.
ui.input-snapshots-are-unavailable-enabl: Input snapshots are unavailable. Enable snapshots in WebRCS, then refresh the connection.
ui.capture-an-input-snapshot-then-import: Capture an input snapshot, then import it into a layer or add it as a fixed reference image.
ui.snapshots-are-reduced-resolution-imag: Snapshots are reduced-resolution images, not a live feed. Their size depends on the device's snapshot settings.
ui.snapshots-are-disabled-for-this-input: Snapshots are disabled for this input. Enable input snapshots in WebRCS and refresh the connection.
ui.reference-images-are-fixed-stills-and: Reference images are fixed stills and never auto-refresh.
ui.at-most-one-request-at-a-time-with-at: At most one request at a time, with at least 5 seconds between requests.
ui.saved-with-this-layer-linked-sends-an: Saved with this layer. Linked sends and loads use this screen and layer. Editing the link does not contact the device.
ui.offline-choose-the-device-family-and-: Offline: choose the device family and enter its native screen/layer IDs.
ui.unmapped-excluded-from-linked-sends-a: Unmapped — excluded from linked sends and loads.
ui.scope-for-both-device-send-and-load-i: Scope for both device send and load. In Folder mode, clicking a folder in the layer list switches the scope.
ui.open-connection-settings-layer-links-: Open connection settings, layer links and send/load options.
ui.last-four-successful-connections-choo: Last four successful connections; choose one to connect
ui.address-saved-automatically-in-applic: Address saved automatically in application settings. Connect reads device data; it does not change layers.
ui.connect-to-a-device-in-connection-set: Connect to a device in Connection settings before transferring layers.
ui.send-the-mapped-editor-layers-to-the-: Send the mapped editor layers to the selected device target
ui.supported-layers-import-geometry-and-: Supported layers import geometry and appearance. Midra explicit fits include crop and mask; Aquilon supports centered crop. Source routing and shared input settings stay on the device.
ui.choose-an-existing-destination-or-new: Choose an existing destination or New layer beside each device layer. The scope limits available destinations; each mapping can still be changed.
ui.no-layers-in-this-scope-choose-all-la: No layers in this scope. Choose All layers, select layers, or choose a folder.
ui.geometry-matches-the-stored-values-se: Geometry matches the stored values. Send applies them to the hardware.
ui.changing-output-preserves-layer-posit: Changing output preserves layer positions and sizes. Custom dimensions are planning sizes, not verified device modes.
ui.viewport-camera-does-not-change-layer: Viewport camera (does not change layer or crop geometry)
ui.these-dimensions-describe-the-editor-: These dimensions describe the editor source, not a device timing command. Local input correction is currently folded into exported layer crop; use the device controls above for the actual shared device input settings.
ui.editor-inputs-share-source-format-and: Editor inputs share source format and input crop between editor layers. Inputs 1–8 are offered initially; add more as needed. This local identity does not select a physical device input or change routing.
ui.custom-input-resolution-retains-the-s: Custom input resolution retains the Source format above.
ui.center-input-crop-to-this-size: Center input crop to this size
ui.input-crop-edges-native-source-pixels: Input crop edges: native source pixels. Native-size changes reset the draft input crop before review.
ui.resizing-automatically-adjusts-the-la: Resizing automatically adjusts the layer crop to fit the new dimensions.
ui.ratio-ready-enable-the-lock-to-resize: Ratio ready; enable the lock to resize.
ui.layer-size-changes-apply-as-you-edit-: Layer size changes apply as you edit. Undo restores earlier values.
ui.source-changes-require-apply-switchin: Source changes require Apply. Switching tabs keeps pending source edits.
ui.the-magenta-box-reveals-pixels-everyt: The magenta box reveals pixels. Everything outside it is blanked; image scale, crop and layer bounds stay unchanged.
ui.drag-any-edge-or-corner-independently: Drag any edge or corner independently; drag inside the layer to move the window. Arrows move 1 output pixel, Shift+arrows 10. Opposite edges may meet to blank everything. Escape cancels a drag; Undo restores it.
ui.mask-proportions-follow-layer-resizin: Mask proportions follow layer resizing. Masking transparent or already cropped pixels has no visible effect.
ui.crop-first-then-fit-into-the-layer-re: Crop first, then fit into the layer rectangle. Resize changes the container; 1:1 keeps the image pixel-for-pixel.
ui.drag-helper-edges-to-trim-without-zoo: Drag helper edges to trim without zooming; drag anywhere inside the layer, including empty margins, to reposition the crop without resizing it. Arrow keys move by 1 source pixel, Shift+arrows by 10. Movement stops at the usable source edges. Double-click toggles the helper.
ui.this-mode-fits-automatically-the-canv: This mode fits automatically. The canvas crop helper is disabled; numeric crop edges remain available here.
ui.edit-crop-edges-here-visual-zoom-drag: Edit crop edges here; visual zoom/drag controls are for normal crop mode.
ui.disabling-advanced-fit-restores-norma: Disabling advanced fit restores normal cover framing. Device subpixel rendering is approximate.
ui.zoom-and-position-change-the-crop-val: Zoom and position change the crop values inside this layer, keeping its visible box fixed. 100% is the minimum crop that fills the box.
ui.crop-zoom-and-offsets-apply-as-you-ed: Crop zoom and offsets apply as you edit. Offsets stop at the content edges and adjust when zoom decreases. Undo restores earlier values.
ui.captured-stills-follow-this-layer-s-i: Captured stills follow this layer’s input and dynamic crops. Guides are drawn above the image; screen references are separate.
ui.to-stage-connect-match-this-layer-s-s: To stage: connect, match this layer's saved mapping and routed input/plug, then enable advanced input edits. Send remains a separate action.
ui.shared-input-corrections-for-this-ada: Shared input corrections for this adapter are managed in WebRCS. Layer crop and zoom remain available in the editor.
ui.advanced-use-only-when-you-need-to-co: Advanced — use only when you need to correct an input and understand the effect.
ui.these-device-controls-map-one-for-one: These device controls map one-for-one to WebRCS Advanced Input settings. Content ratio / Transform to change the input's aspect before layer framing. Usually leave them set on the Midra.
ui.input-crop-removes-source-edges-befor: Input crop removes source edges before dynamic layer crop / zoom. It does not resize the layer's bounding box. This processing is a Midra feature, not an editor-only effect.
ui.edit-advanced-input-settings-and-incl: Edit advanced input settings and include my edits when sending
ui.off-by-default-only-edited-device-fie: Off by default. Only edited device fields are sent, and only with layers using that input. Inputs are shared: edits can affect other layers and Program too. Uncheck to discard staged edits. This opt-in lasts for this session only.
ui.connect-and-map-this-layer-to-a-midra: Connect and map this layer to a Midra input source to inspect its advanced settings. No device input edits are staged offline.
ui.saving-a-proposal-is-opt-in-project-s: Saving a proposal is opt-in. Project saves and extra-parameter exports retain it; reopening never stages or sends it.
ui.edits-wait-for-send-opening-this-tab-: Edits wait for Send; opening this tab or enabling the checkbox sends nothing. Refresh/load after sending to inspect the device's resulting content dimensions.
language.label: Language / Langue
language.preview: Unverified machine translations. Some advanced controls and diagnostics remain in English; device terminology stays in English.
ui.or-drag-png-jpeg-or-bmp-images-into-t: Or drag PNG, JPEG or BMP images into the window.
ui.loading-image-current-reference-remai: Loading image… current reference remains available.
ui.reference-stays-fixed-behind-layers-w: Reference stays fixed behind layers. Warnings never block placement.
ui.paste-layer-values-to-review-their-ge: Paste layer values to review their geometry and destinations.
ui.choose-a-destination-for-each-item-be: Choose a destination for each item below. Other layers stay unchanged.
ui.use-supplied-source-names-unnamed-ite: Use supplied source names. Unnamed items and destination folders stay unchanged.
ui.copy-exact-crop-edges-offsets-and-fit: Copy exact crop edges, offsets and fit mode. Source dimensions after input crop must match; source assignments remain unchanged.
ui.copy-the-four-proportional-mask-edges: Copy the four proportional mask edges without resizing the layer.
ui.unchecked-values-keep-the-destination: Unchecked values keep the destination settings. Format changes may adjust existing crops to fit.
ui.outline-adjustment-requires-format-po: Outline adjustment requires Format. Position uses the source top-left when enabled.
ui.each-included-item-needs-a-different-: Each included item needs a different destination.
ui.background-artwork-excluded-from-laye: Background artwork · excluded from layer mapping
ui.no-source-name-destination-name-stays: No source name; destination name stays unchanged.
ui.drag-to-reorder-double-click-to-renam: Drag to reorder · double-click to rename · right-click for actions
ui.applies-to-layer-sizing-crop-zoom-alw: Applies to layer sizing. Crop zoom always keeps the source proportions.
ui.read-the-clipboard-and-review-which-v: Read the clipboard and review which values and layers to apply.
ui.change-crop-zoom-and-offset-inside-th: Change crop zoom and offset inside the layer; keep its visible box fixed.
ui.overlay-grid-visibility-subdivisions-: Overlay grid — visibility, subdivisions and snapping
ui.snapping-tools-and-options-shift-10-p: Snapping tools and options. Shift: 10 px · Ctrl+Shift: 100 px · Alt: invert snapping.
ui.pivot-resize-click-to-toggle-hold-ctr: Pivot resize — click to toggle. Hold Ctrl for the same effect; if selected, Ctrl temporarily disables it. Combines with either grid. Drag the pivot: snaps to 9 layer anchors and enabled grids/edges; Alt bypasses anchors. Double-click to center. Applies to layer and crop/zoom handles.
ui.import-layer-values-or-reference-imag: Import layer values or reference image
ui.would-you-like-to-apply-changes: Would you like to apply changes?
ui.native-pixels-1-image-pixel-1-screen-: Native pixels (1 image pixel = 1 screen pixel)
ui.saves-applied-values-and-reference-im: Saves applied values and reference images.
ui.map-editor-layers-review-device-chang: Map editor layers, review device changes and send explicitly.
ui.show-source-patterns-with-the-current: Show source patterns with the current crop and mask. These are not live captures.
ui.keep-an-editable-snapshot-of-these-la: Keep an editable snapshot of these layers. Restore it from the Project menu; other editors may remove it.
ui.source-settings-crop-fit-blanking-map: Source settings, crop, fit, blanking, mappings, inactive input proposals and workspace settings. Reference images and captured previews are excluded. The snapshot stays at its original values if artwork is edited elsewhere.
ui.this-format-cannot-carry-editable-set: This format cannot carry editable settings. Save a .pilot.json project alongside it.
ui.reading-project-and-decoding-referenc: Reading project and decoding reference images…
ui.opening-replaces-the-current-work-und: Opening replaces the current work, undo history and recovery autosave. Embedded parameters restore the original export snapshot, not later artwork edits. Cancel and save a separate project first if needed.
ui.fixed-guide-double-click-its-row-for-: Fixed guide · double-click its row for settings.
ui.select-a-layer-or-drag-a-selection-bo: Select a layer, or drag a selection box.
ui.shift-click-to-add-or-remove-layers: Shift-click to add or remove layers.
ui.layer-resolution-click-for-layer-prop: LAYER RESOLUTION · CLICK FOR LAYER PROPERTIES
ui.layer-properties-crops-provisional-de: Layer properties: crops / provisional device mapping
ui.or-ctrl-cmd-v-with-the-viewport-focus: Or Ctrl/Cmd-V with the viewport focused
ui.drag-or-nudge-to-move-the-selection-t: Drag or nudge to move the selection together.
ui.use-the-toolbar-alignment-menu-to-ali: Use the toolbar alignment menu to align layers.
ui.numeric-edits-require-one-selected-la: Numeric edits require one selected layer.
ui.save-staged-input-edits-as-a-project-: Save staged input edits as a project proposal
menu.title: Menu
transfer.read-help: Read fresh Preview geometry and cropping from the device into the linked editor layers. Undo restores the previous layout.
crop.help-mask: Mask blanks pixels without moving or scaling the image. Drag the magenta edges or move the window inside the layer.
crop.help-auto: Centered and Cropped fit automatically. Edit numeric crop edges in Crop properties if needed.
crop.help-native: Drag edges to trim; drag anywhere inside the layer to reposition the crop. Movement preserves crop size, pixel scale and the container.
crop.help-advanced: Opens advanced crop edges and fit mode. The rectangle defines the container.
crop.help-normal: Changes the crop values inside this layer. Drag content to reposition it; the visible box stays fixed.
language.confirm: Does this new language choice suit you?
language.rollback: Your previous language returns in %{seconds} seconds unless you confirm.
language.cancel: No, I clicked on this language by accident
access.text-help: Additional scaling for standard controls. Canvas artwork and fixed-size labels follow interface scale.
